title: Fix ES module directory imports in @object-ui/core and patch Next.js DoS vulnerability
body:
CI was failing with `Error: Directory import '.../@object-ui/core/dist/types' is not supported resolving ES modules`. The package is configured with `"type": "module"` but TypeScript source files used bare imports without `.js` extensions.

## Changes

### ES Module Imports (@object-ui/core)
- Added `.js` extensions to all relative imports/exports across 10 files
- Removed 12 stale `.js`/`.d.ts` stub files from `src/` that prevented TypeScript compilation

**Before:**
```typescript
export * from './types/index';
export * from './evaluator/index';
import { ExpressionEvaluator } from '../evaluator/ExpressionEvaluator';
```

**After:**
```typescript
export * from './types/index.js';
export * from './evaluator/index.js';
import { ExpressionEvaluator } from '../evaluator/ExpressionEvaluator.js';
```

### Security
- Updated Next.js 16.1.4 → 16.1.5 (patches HTTP request deserialization DoS in React Server Components)
